content.text:
When you **_spill your blood on the soil and speak_** **_the words of convocation_**, the spirits of the soil will stir and wake, filling the soil with life and energy and nutrients.

When you **_cast this spell on the fields in early_** **_spring, spilling a scary amount of your blood_**, mark all three debilities and lose all but 1 HP. If the steading spends 1 Surplus to plant in the fallow fields, this autumn’s harvest will generate 1d4+1 extra Surplus.

However, you must roll +WIS: **on a 10+**, there is no consequence; **on a 7-9**, before midsummer, you must water the soil with the lifeblood of a large, healthy beast (like a horse, mule, wisent, or aurochs) or else the extra crops will fail and the extra Surplus will be lost; **on a 6-**, the spell works but you stir some dangerous spirit or growth from the soil, or set free some evil imprisoned in the earth.
